entry.title: A Completely and Totally Ordinary Family Holiday
entry.summary:
Author: koddarc

Rating: Teen And Up AudiencesLanguage: EnglishWords: 11,292Chapters: 7/9Kudos: 35

Summary: Bruce must be having some kind of mid-life crisis because, after more than a decade of parenthood, he's decided that it's finally time to attempt a family holiday. Which is a lot easier said than done when at least two of your sons are homicidal maniacs and probably all of them have good reason to hate you. For reasons he himself can't explain, Dick agrees to help Bruce try to make this trip to Europe a success. Chaos ensues. Read on for general batfamily antics, drunken father-son bonding, Bruce Wayne having fun and just generally a lot of fluff, with sprinklings of culture and emotions.   The first time that Bruce mentioned it, remarking in an offhand, uninspired way that they ought to go on a family holiday, Dick had thought that it was a joke. “Ha ha.” He replied dryly. “I don’t even want to think about what that would be like.” His adoptive father was near impossible to read and prided himself on this. Still, Dick had known and lived with him long enough now to recognise the barely perceptible signs of his face falling- stiffened jaw, colder than usual eyes, a hand defensively combing through his hair. “Oh.” Dick frowned. “You were serious.”
